newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end up on good company results.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end up on good company results.

text.p: Shares on edged higher Wednesday on good company results and market enthusiasm, but with modest volumes ahead of the Labor day holiday.

The blue-chip index .ISEL closed up 0.63 percent at 2,566.21 points, with a volume of 48.7 million soles of shares traded, according to preliminary figures. The general index .IGRA rose 0.51 percent to 1,758.77.

"Investors' expectations regarding company results have borne fruit, but investors have only picked up shares in companies which have had better-than-expected results," said Walter Hernandez, trader at brokerage ACCVAL.
Attention was focused on miner Buenaventura , whose first quarter results were among the most encouraging.
The share closed up 2.24 percent at 22.80 soles, with 26,520 shares traded.
Buenaventura's first quarter profit jumped to 63.9 million soles, compared with the same period in 1996 when it posted a profit 16.9 million.
Volumes were driven higher by investor interest in blue- chip leader Telefonica de Peru and holding company Credicorp.
Peru's main brewery Backus y Johnston rose 2.2 percent to 2.32 soles, with 861,546.00 shares traded.
B shares in telecom company Telefonica del Peru closed soft, up 0.31 percent at 6.42 soles, with 364,834 shares traded.
Traders said Telefonica was a share likely to gain further ground in coming months.
Utility company Luz del Sur rose 0.95 percent to 3.14 soles, with more than 1.2 million shares traded.
The Lima Stock Exchange is closed on Thursday because of the public holiday.
